blocks.label: Suggested use
paragraphs: Formulated to easy mixing. Add one scoop (included) to 6-8 fl oz (180 ml - 240 ml) of water, milk or your favorite beverage and mix thoroughly. Enjoy prior to workouts, within 30 minutes after workouts or anytime you desire a high-quality, high-protein drink.

blocks.label: Warnings
